name: Hive 1.5.2
notes: Two collaboration fixes. Inviting by handle created a new key epoch sealed only to the invitee — so the inviter (and existing members) could no longer decrypt anything after the invite ('no key for epoch N'), silently breaking the room. The invite now seals the new epoch to the invitee AND every current member, including your own device. And leaving a workspace now clears the sync pointer, so the room isn't re-added on the next launch (leave used to put you right back in).
